answer: Every bond departs through one vault exit queue: the trigger is any withdrawal request, the rule clears five identities per epoch, oldest first. A farmer funding clones on credit must park each deposit twenty epochs or auction the claim at a thirty percent discount. A hundred fakes lock 500,000 POA behind walnut-thick gates, and early liquidity burns 150,000 POA off the fleet at once, a zenith of illiquidity honest operators never touch.
